title: Should You Choose ElevenLabs AI Caption Generator? A Decision Guide
markdown:
ElevenLabs AI Caption Generator is worth considering if your immediate need is to turn short video files into editable, time-synced captions. The product page says it accepts `.mp4`, `.mov`, and `.mkv` uploads up to 10 minutes or 50MB, and that its editor can correct words, adjust caption segments, and assign speakers. [ElevenLabs Caption Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/caption-generator)

It is a closer fit for creators working with talking-head clips, screen recordings, podcasts, interviews, or short social edits than for a single long, finished production: ElevenLabs specifically advises trimming longer edits into the clips you plan to post and captioning each cut separately. It also states that captions can be generated in 90+ languages, with speaker labeling for up to 32 speakers and audio-event tags such as laughter or applause. [ElevenLabs Caption Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/caption-generator)

Check the export path before deciding. The listed exports include SRT, VTT, TXT, DOCX, PDF, JSON, and HTML; ElevenLabs says SRT and VTT can be imported into CapCut, Premiere Pro, and native platform editors. That makes it sensible to test one representative clip and confirm that the exported file works in your own editing workflow. [ElevenLabs Caption Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/caption-generator)

Cost should be evaluated against your wider ElevenLabs use, not captions in isolation. ElevenLabs says the caption generator can be tried for free without a subscription, while paid plans offer higher limits, advanced features, and API access. Its pricing page lists a Free plan at $0 with 10,000 monthly credits and a Starter plan at $6 per month with 30,000 credits; it also says credits are shared across products and prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. [ElevenLabs Caption Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/caption-generator) [ElevenLabs Pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

Choose it when the file limits, language needs, editing controls, and export formats match a real clip you need to publish. Hold off on a paid plan until you have tested that clip and reviewed the current plan terms for your usage.

Disclosure: This article contains an affiliate link.

Try the caption generator with a representative video: https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-caption-generator-en-1
